In addition to this week's $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, alongside $100 off the entire AirPods Max 2 lineup and AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low, the highlight of 9to5Toys' Lunch Break today is a series of eye-catching MacBook Pro deals—up to $320 off the M5, $400 off the M5 Pro, and more. We also have plenty of other notable deals, including $169 off this titanium Apple Watch Series 11 cellular model (which likely won't last long), plus up to $220 off iPhone 17 Pro (Amazon Renewed Premium), as well as a collection of Satechi accessory markdowns—the metal/reinforced glass Find My wallet card, Find My keychain tag, its OntheGo Magnetic 7-in-1 USB-C hub, and its stylish space gray metal 25W 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand all hitting all-time lows. See all the details below.

You can still find $170 off this M5 MacBook Pro 1TB with the 96W Apple charger upgrade, as well as $320 off the 24GB RAM model, but we also have deals on select M5 Pro models with up to $400 off their newer pricing.

B&H is currently running some particularly noteworthy MacBook Pro deals with prices below Amazon's, or offering significant discounts on configurations Amazon doesn't carry—we've pulled them out from the list above for clarity:

This titanium Apple Watch Series 11 cellular model just hit one of its best prices ever at $169 off

Beyond the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models with $100 off starting from $299, we just spotted a noteworthy and likely fleeting opportunity to grab the Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular in the natural titanium case at $169 below its retail price.

Amazon is currently offering the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular with natural titanium case and stone gray sport band for as low as $529.97 with free shipping.

This configuration, which normally sells for $699, is now steeply discounted by $169, making it one of the lowest prices we've tracked to date.

This model did briefly drop to $515 during Prime Day earlier this year, but sold out quickly and has been hard to find on Amazon since. Before that, we'd never seen it below $569.

If this deal follows the pattern of other similarly marked-down cellular models we've tracked, it should sell out soon.

Beyond its higher retail price due to Apple's premium titanium case and cellular connectivity, this is indeed a more niche configuration, but this discount is genuinely worthwhile.

If you're more interested in the base models, here's an overview of current pricing:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $329 (originally $429)

July Prime Day iPhone 17 Pro deals up to $220 off (Amazon Renewed Premium), or up to $449 off the 17 Pro Max

We've tracked quite a few opportunities to grab a refurbished iPhone 17 Pro this year, but we want to highlight Amazon's top-tier Renewed Premium discounts for July Prime Day—you can now snag an iPhone 17 Pro for up to $220 off, with a one-year Amazon Renewed guarantee.

July Prime Day iPhone 17 Pro deals

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Cosmic Orange for $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Deep Blue for $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Silver for $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Cosmic Orange for $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Deep Blue for $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Silver for $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)

These items are shipped and sold directly by Amazon, come with a one-year Amazon Renewed guarantee, and feature "over 90% original battery life." Beyond the actual condition being Amazon's best refurbished offering, this is also the main distinction between Amazon's "Premium Refurbished" and Renewed Premium tiers—you get a full year of warranty and a normal battery.

Yes, we've seen Premium Refurbished units go for even less, but when it comes to high-quality device deals, Amazon's Renewed Premium remains one of, if not the most worthwhile option to consider.

As for the larger iPhone 17 Pro Max, Woot's ongoing deal remains hard to beat. These are "flawless, never-customer-handled brand new units," complete with "test stickers showing 100% battery life, and a stylish custom black box." In other words, they're essentially brand new, but you won't get the original Apple packaging, and they "don't qualify for AppleCare." However, with up to $449 off, for some it seems like a worthwhile trade-off.

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB for $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB for $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB for $1,550 (originally $1,999)

Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2 see $100 discount for July Prime Day (all colors)

Beyond the ongoing $50 off AirPods Pro 3 deal and the new AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low, one of the better July Prime Day deals is $100 off the 2026 AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is currently offering Apple's latest AirPods Max 2 for $449 with free shipping, a straight $100 off its $549 retail price, making it the best deal available right now.

This offer applies to all five colors: Midnight, Blue, Orange, Starlight, and Orange.

Since its launch earlier this year, this is the lowest price we've tracked for the latest generation of Apple's over-ear headphones, excluding the brief Prime Day deals (most of which sold out before the event ended). Today's offer is only the second time we've seen it priced lower than $50 off since release.

Apple's iPhone Air MagSafe Battery just dropped back to its 40%-off all-time low

iPhone Air hits new all-time low at $159 off for July Prime Day

Beyond the ongoing summer deals on AirPods Pro 3, new Apple deals have arrived this week, including AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low and $100 off AirPods Max 2. But we've also tracked one of the best prices yet on the brand new unlocked iPhone Air, with $159 off.

As part of Best Buy's July Prime Day promotion, you can now find all Apple iPhone Air models with $160 off their retail price:

  • iPhone Air 256GB for $840 (originally $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB for $1,040 (originally $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB for $1,240 (originally $1,400)

Best Buy has been the best place to grab iPhone Air deals since its fall 2025 launch. This ultra-thin Apple phone previously only saw discounts up to $149 (mentioned in early June), but all models are now $10 lower than our previous mention, making this the best deal we've tracked from reputable sources.

You'll find some cheaper used and refurbished options on Amazon, but for brand new unlocked units, Best Buy is your go-to.

That said, Amazon has slightly better pricing on other current Apple products compared to Best Buy's July Prime Day deals:

  • AirTag 2 4-pack for $89 (originally $99)—matching its all-time low
